name: 60. Bedrock Kimi reasoning signature replay fail-soft
description:
reasoningContent.reasoningText.signature is minted and verified by Anthropic models only. A conversation that
switches model mid-flight - a routing rule, a fallback, or a client picking a new model per turn - replays the
earlier model's signature onto whatever answers next, and a non-Anthropic Bedrock model refuses it outright:

  400 ValidationException: "This model doesn't support the reasoningContent.reasoningText.signature field.
       Remove reasoningContent.reasoningText.signature and try again."

Production path: POST /v1/chat/completions -> ChatAssistantMessage.ReasoningDetails[].Signature ->
bedrock convertMessage (core/providers/bedrock/utils.go) -> reasoningContent.reasoningText.signature on Converse.
core/encryptedreasoning.go's fail-soft is what heals it: isEncryptedReasoningRejection recognises the refusal,
stripChatUnverifiableReasoning clears every signature, and the request is retried once on the same key.

The detector originally required the upstream to say the payload was UNVERIFIABLE (invalid / could not be
verified / malformed). Bedrock's wording here says the opposite - the field is not accepted at all - so it
matched no marker, no strip ran, and the 400 reached the client. unsupportedFieldMarkers closes that.

Coverage note: folder 44 pins the same fail-soft, but only on /openai/v1/responses for Anthropic and OpenAI
models - a different carrier (encrypted_content on a reasoning item) and a different strip function
(stripResponsesEncryptedContent). This folder is the chat-shape, non-Anthropic-Bedrock half.

FIXTURE CONSTRAINT - do not 'clean up' these bodies. The signature on the assistant turn IS the trigger; a case
that drops it silently stops testing anything (case 3 is the deliberate signature-free control). The signature
value is a fixture and is not expected to verify anywhere - being unverifiable is the point.

item.name: bedrock/moonshotai.kimi-k2.5 /v1/chat/completions foreign reasoning signature degrades - failsoft

exec: pm.test('foreign reasoning signature degrades instead of 400ing', function () {
pm.expect(body, 'Bedrock rejection reached the client; the reasoning-replay fail-soft did not fire').to.not.include('reasoningContent.reasoningText.signature');
pm.expect(pm.response.json().choices, 'no choices returned after the stripped retry').to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty;
